sop: SOP-QA-012 Batch record review and release (synthetic)

rows.text: All drug product production and control records, including those for packaging and labeling, shall be reviewed and approved by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To set out how the executed batch manufacturing and packaging records of each batch are reviewed before the batch is released for sale.

3. The batch record

3.1 Each batch record is an accurate copy of the approved master record for the product. 3.2 Operators record each step as it is done: equipment used, weights and measures of each component, lot numbers, in-process results, the actual yield, and the signatures of the person who did and the person who checked each significant step. 3.3 The packaging part of the record holds a specimen of every label used and the label reconciliation.

4. Review

4.1 Production reviews the record for completeness within two working days of packing. 4.2 QA then checks every entry against the master record and the specifications. 4.3 Any deviation, out-of-specification result or yield outside the stated limits is investigated before release, whether or not the batch has already been distributed, and the investigation is extended to other batches that may be affected. 4.4 The written record of each investigation states its conclusion and follow-up.

rows.text: Any unexplained discrepancy (including a percentage of theoretical yield exceeding the maximum or minimum percentages established in master production and control records) or the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications shall be thoroughly investigated, whether or not the batch has already been distributed.
